title: SDE 3 + Senior Instructor - DSA
description:
**About Newton:** Newton School of Technology (NST) is a new\-age institution redefining technical education in India. Founded by IIT alumni, NST offers a 4\-year B.Tech in Computer Science and AI, focused on hands\-on learning and deep industry integration. Within two years, over 93% of students have secured paid internships with companies like Razorpay, SarvamAI, and DRDO, along with global exposure through tech treks to Singapore and Silicon Valley. Led by a distinguished faculty comprising ICPC World Finalists and ex\-professionals from ISRO, Microsoft, MakeMyTrip, and several other leading tech organizations, NST is building a scalable, high\-impact model that produces industry\-ready talent for the world’s most advanced technology roles.

**About the Role:** We are looking for an SDE 2/3 \+ Senior Technical Instructor – Data Structures \& Algorithms (DSA) to join our Computer Science Department. This is an academic\-focused technical role for professionals who bring a strong combination of DSA expertise, software engineering experience, teaching/mentoring ability, and academic depth. The ideal candidate will have an M.Tech/M.E. or PhD along with strong expertise in Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem Solving, and Core Computer Science. The role involves teaching foundational and advanced DSA concepts, conducting hands\-on coding labs, mentoring students, and preparing them for competitive programming, technical interviews, and real\-world engineering challenges.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Course Development \& Delivery \-**

● Design and deliver engaging lectures, coding sessions, and practical labs on Data Structures, Algorithms, Problem Solving, and Algorithm Analysis.

● Teach both foundational concepts and advanced algorithmic problem\-solving techniques.

● Develop structured course content, assignments, coding exercises, and assessments.

**Algorithmic Foundations** 

● Teach algorithmic paradigms including: ○ Brute Force ○ Greedy Algorithms ○ Divide \& Conquer ○ Dynamic Programming ○ Backtracking ○ Branch \& Bound ○ Graph Algorithms ○ Searching, Sorting and Optimization

● Explain time and space complexity and help students develop efficient problem\-solving approaches.

**Lab \& Problem\-Solving Mentorship**

● Lead coding and problem\-solving labs where students implement, debug, analyse and optimise algorithms.

● Mentor students on structured thinking, debugging, optimisation, and solving problems under constraints.

● Help students prepare for technical interviews, competitive programming, and coding competitions.

**Academic Excellence \& Student Success**

● Review assignments, coding submissions, projects, and assessments.

● Provide continuous and actionable feedback to improve student performance.

● Identify high\-potential students and mentor them toward advanced problem\-solving and competitive programming.

**Industry \& Academic Integration**

● Bridge academic fundamentals with real\-world software engineering practices.

● Bring relevant industry examples, engineering problems, and practical use cases into the classroom.

● Collaborate with faculty, curriculum designers, and industry mentors to continuously improve course quality.

**Research \& Innovation**

● Encourage students to participate in competitive programming, research projects, open\-source contributions and coding competitions.

● Support research\-oriented problem\-solving and algorithmic exploration.

● Contribute to academic initiatives, technical communities, and knowledge\-sharing sessions

**Stakeholder Engagement**

● Collaborate with university leadership, faculty members, and industry partners.

● Participate in technical workshops, masterclasses, hackathons, coding contests, and academic events.

● Contribute to building a strong Computer Science academic and technical community.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

● M.Tech / M.E. / PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Information Technology, or a closely related discipline.

● 6\+ years of relevant experience across software engineering, technical teaching, competitive programming, research, or algorithm\-focused problem\-solving.

● Strong proficiency in at least one programming language such as C\+\+, Java or Python.

● Strong command of: ○ Data Structures \& Algorithms ○ Algorithm Design \& Analysis ○ Object\-Oriented Programming ○ Problem Solving ○ Core Computer Science

● Strong understanding of algorithmic paradigms and their practical applications.

● Ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear, structured, and approachable manner.

● Comfortable teaching both conceptual theory and hands\-on coding.

● Strong interest in teaching, mentoring, and student development.

**Preferred Background**

We are particularly interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

● M.Tech from a reputed institute/university with strong DSA/CS fundamentals.

● PhD in Computer Science / AI / Mathematics / related areas, particularly with research or publications in algorithms, theoretical CS, AI/ML, or related domains.

● Software engineering experience at SDE 2/SDE 3 or equivalent level.

● Prior experience teaching or mentoring students at universities, colleges, coding academies, bootcamps, or corporate training programs.

● Competitive programming background — ICPC, Codeforces, CodeChef, LeetCode, or similar.

● Experience designing problem sets, coding contests, technical assessments, or interview questions.

● Experience mentoring students for technical interviews or competitive programming.

● Contributions to open\-source projects, technical blogs, research publications, or developer communities.

● Strong academic\-industry collaboration experience.

**Who Would Be a Good Fit?**

We are looking for professionals who can combine technical depth \+ academic rigour \+ mentorship.

**Potential profiles could include:** 

● M.Tech \+ 6\-10 years industry experience \+ strong DSA

● M.Tech \+ SDE 2/SDE 3 or equivalent \+ teaching/mentoring experience

● PhD \+ strong DSA / Algorithms / CS fundamentals \+ teaching experience

● PhD \+ industry experience in software engineering / AI/algorithms

● Senior software engineers who have transitioned into technical education, mentoring, or academic roles

● Academicians with strong DSA, competitive programming, or industry exposure

**Why Join Newton School of Technology?**

● Be part of a mission\-driven institution focused on bridging the gap between education and employability.

● Work with ICPC World Finalists, ex\-Google professionals, ex\-ISRO scientists, and IIT/IISc mentors.

● Exposure to real\-world projects, open\-source initiatives, and industry collaborations.

● Opportunity to shape the next generation of problem solvers and software engineers.

● Contribute to a rigorous, industry\-oriented, and placement\-focused Computer Science curriculum.

● Engage with a growing ecosystem of 2,000\+ hiring partners..

Pay: ₹2,500,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you interested in a full\-time role combining DSA mentoring with hands\-on work on real\-world software projects?
* Are you open to working on a university payroll while mentoring B.Tech CSE students and contributing to real\-world projects?
* What is your Notice period?
* What is your current CTC?
* What is your Expected CTC?

title: Software Engineer III
description:

The Marketing Transformation team is part of USCDT, employs a ground\-breaking focus with development responsibilities for customer \& marketer facing capabilities that deepen and expand digital engagement, as well as core technical capabilities that cut across business lines and customer segments. title: Software Development Engineer-II
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


**Introduction to the Team:**

This role is under Platform Quality team \& We are looking for high performing individual contributor who has worked prior on or willing to work on Scalable internal tools \& utilities creation for developer productivity enhancement.


Must have developed Internal or industry standard based web or native app test automation solution which is highly stable \& scalable.


**In this role, you will:**

* Design, develop, and maintain robust test automation frameworks, internal tools, and utilities that leverage AI/ML‑enabled solutions to enhance developer productivity and accelerate release cycles.
* Write clean, maintainable, and optimized code using strong knowledge of software design principles, data structures, design patterns, and computer science fundamentals across multiple tech stacks including native mobile apps, web, and APIs.
* Investigate and perform root cause analysis (RCA) of test failures and system issues, using deep understanding of the surrounding systems, logs, and monitoring to design and implement durable fixes.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test coverage, failure detection, and feedback loops, while ensuring reliability, observability, and maintainability of these solutions in production workflows.
* Utilize and refine industry‑standard test automation frameworks, CI/CD workflows (such as GitHub Actions), and operational tooling (such as RCP/MCP servers, Datadog, Splunk) to continuously improve quality and efficiency.
* Collaborate across teams to identify and resolve inefficiencies in code, tools, and processes, driving cross‑organizational improvements, documenting major technical initiatives (including RCAs), and sharing learnings with broader groups.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience.
* 2\+ years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional software development or test automation engineering experience, including building and debugging applications and internal tools, with strength in at least one programming language and exposure to multiple technology implementations.
* Working knowledge of industry‑standard testing and monitoring tools for automated and distributed systems, and the ability to interpret system behavior and logs to perform effective RCA of failures.
* Ability to design and implement code and framework changes that improve stability, reliability, and test effectiveness across services or components, including familiarity with CI/CD workflows and observability tooling.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing software, automation frameworks, or internal tools in at least two programming languages (such as Java and Python), including designing and maintaining test automation systems or high‑usage internal utilities from scratch.
* Proven ability to apply design patterns for scalable, maintainable systems and frameworks, including system design (low‑level design), API design, and data modeling for test and tooling platforms.
* Demonstrated impact in selecting appropriate technologies and architectures to solve business and quality needs, connecting team goals to broader business outcomes and identifying project‑level business problems with corresponding technical solutions.
* Familiarity with AI‑driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products, including safely integrating and operating AI/ML‑enabled solutions that improve test automation, developer workflows, or quality insights.
* Experience operating test automation and internal tooling at scale, including optimizing CI/CD pipelines, observability (Datadog, Splunk), and reliability for multi‑service or cross‑platform environments.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.  



  

**Important notice**

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. **Equal Opportunity**

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: AI Customer Engineer, Public Sector, Google Cloud
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text\-to\-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, Cloud infrastructure, Agentic AI, and cloud networking.

* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.



As an AI Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of complex, specialized workloads. You will leverage your deep expertise in strategic product areas in partnership with Platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs\-of\-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI\-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development.


It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go\-To\-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer\-tailored solutions that secure buy\-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go\-To\-Market team.
* Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

title: Sr Test Engineer - Automation (Selenium + Java + Playwright +AI Testing)
description:
**About Gartner IT:**  

Join a world\-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients. We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that power Gartner. Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.
  

  

**About the role:**  

Gartner is looking for a well\-rounded and motivated test engineer to join its agile, scrum\-based Sales and Services technology team which is responsible for testing web, agentic and API applications and integrations to support its continuous delivery. You will contribute to maintenance and development of test automation frameworks and leverage AI tools for testing deliverables. This role requires technical skills and a collaborative approach in a fast\-paced Agile environment
  

  

**What you will do:**

* Develop and maintain quality assurance plans, test data, procedures, and scripts.
* Ability to execute functional testing along with an ability to identify opportunities for automation and create scripts. Design, build, and maintain effective test automation solutions which meet requirements and specifications. (Smoke, Functional, Regression, etc.)
* Leverage AI\-driven tools and techniques to strengthen both manual and automated testing workflows — including AI\-assisted test case generation, intelligent test execution, and automated result and support the validation of internally built AI agents
* Exposure to web technologies
* Ensure accurate and complete converges of designated test areas.
* Write effective manual/automated test scripts within the framework of approved testing tools using documented requirements and technical specifications provided by project team
* Provide test status, document defects and potential risks
* Effectively document defects using automated defect tracking software.
* Understand new product requirements and coordinate work across multiple project phases or complex assignments.
* Demonstrate attention to detail and the ability to balance quality, timelines, and resource constraints to deliver high\-quality products.

**What you will need :**  

Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in testing applications via both manual and automated tests. The candidate should have strong qualitative and quantitative problem\-solving skills along with high level of ownership and accountability. Ability to work in a collaborative team environment with good interpersonal skills.
  

  

**Must have:**

* 4\-6 years’ experience in an IT or Business environment testing highly scalable applications with significant experience designing automation platforms and writing automated tests
* **Proficiency in automating web applications across platforms using test automation tools and frameworks, including Selenium, TestNG, Playwright and/or Pytest test framework.**
* **Experience with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, Jmeter), including an ability to customize the code for load test creation.**
* **Well\-versed in Java/Git Source control.**
* **Experience in writing SQL queries, procedures, and function.**
* **Knowledge of Salesforce platform and database validation using SOQL**
* Hands on experience testing web services
* **Strong exposure to AI\-driven or agentic testing approaches leveraging multiple AI models**
* Expertise in QA prompt engineering, including designing and optimizing prompts to effectively drive AI agents for test generation, execution, and validation
* Able to independently support projects and work with various stakeholders

**What you are:**

* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent degree in Computer Science or a related field required
* Excellent communication and prioritization skills.
* Able to work independently or within a team proactively in a fast\-paced AGILE\-SCRUM environment.
* Owns success – Takes responsibility for successful delivery of the solutions.
* Strong desire to improve upon their skills in software testing and technologies

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.


\#LI\-SS9


**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.


Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.


Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.


**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.


We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.  



  

**Introduction to team**

The Lodging connectivity Organization at Expedia Group is seeking an experienced backend developer and a seasoned technologist with a passion for building robust, scalable, and high\-performance applications that help millions of people plan their travels and create lifelong memories. Join us as we revolutionize the travel industry!  

  



The organization owns a core lever of Expedia Group's growth: expanding global lodging supply and making it a source of competitive advantage. We build and operate the platform that sources, normalizes, and serves third\-party lodging inventory — powering the shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys that travelers rely on every day. Through resilient API integrations and AI agentic workflows, we bring diverse partner content onto a single platform and make it competitive, accurate, and bookable at scale.


We are part of the partner connectivity platform that serves as the backbone of Expedia's business, powering an efficient two\-way marketplace that bridges supply and demand. Our platform sources properties and handles more than 3M transactions per minute. Built with modern technologies like Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Kafka, DynamoDB, ML, Elasticsearch, and Redis on AWS, our ecosystem supports millions of travelers in finding the best travel products tailored to their needs.  

  



If you're passionate about creating transformative solutions, tackling large\-scale engineering challenges, and shaping the future of lodging supply, we'd love to have you on our team. Join us, and let's redefine the way the world travels together!  

  



**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and evolve scalable, reliable services and software components, including system design, low\-level design, API design, and data modeling to support customer\-facing and platform experiences.
* Lead the technical design across domains and delivery of complex, multi\-quarter initiatives across the 3PI supply system that support shopping, booking, servicing, and claims journeys.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of complex features or services, from technical design through implementation, deployment, monitoring, and iterative improvement in production.
* Break down large, ambiguous business problems into clear technical solutions that can be reused across multiple domains and services, driving streamlined execution by the team.
* Write, review, and maintain high\-quality, well\-tested code while driving best practices in code quality, security, observability, resilience, and performance.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by reducing incidents, enhancing observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML\-enabled solutions that improve traveler and business outcomes, applying AI\-driven systems, tools, and workflows to production\-grade software.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and architecture, and raising the overall engineering bar for the team.
* Partner with product, analytics, design, and engineering teams to apply data\-driven decision making, define success metrics, and improve system health and user outcomes over time.
* Contribute to architectural direction by participating in design reviews, proposing improvements, leading communities of practice, and helping shape long\-term technical strategy.
Technologies we use: Java, Kotlin, Spring, GraphQL, Docker, Kafka, DynamoDB, Cassandra, Elasticsearch, Redis, Datadog, Splunk, and AWS cloud.  
* 

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 10\+ years of professional, post\-college backend software development experience in an object\-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end\-to\-end delivery for services or components — design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support — within a multi\-service or multi\-domain environment.
* Deep understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures, with a strong command of core engineering practices including object\-oriented design, testing, and version control.
* Hands\-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable, maintainable systems.
* Hands\-on expertise with AI/ML frameworks and tools, and experience applying AI/ML concepts to real\-world products.
* Experience building on cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) with sound architectural patterns and scalable, cost\-efficient, production\-quality systems.
Strong communication skills and a highly effective collaborator — able to articulate ideas to teammates, peers, and leaders, support them with data, and incorporate others' feedback to find common ground.  
* 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high\-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low\-level designs.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data\-informed tradeoffs across scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Experience with partner or third\-party integrations, supply/inventory systems, or high\-volume marketplace platforms.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Experience leading cross\-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI\-assisted development and testing tools.
* A self\-starter who embraces change and is always open to replacing what you built yesterday with something better today.

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation .  



  

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/ .

Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

title: BI Developer – Databricks
description:
About This Role
**10 years of experience**  

**Skills: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, SQL, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Python, DAX, Data Modelling, ETL / ELT, Azure / AWS, Unity Catalog, Medallion Architecture, Data Governance, Performance Tuning**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Senior BI Developer with 10\+ years of experience and deep Databricks expertise to design, build, and maintain enterprise\-grade data and analytics solutions. You will combine strong Databricks platform knowledge with solid BI development skills delivering scalable, performant, and governed data pipelines and analytical solutions that drive business decision making across the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and maintain Databricks\-based data pipelines and analytical solutions using PySpark, Delta Lake, and SQL across Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold layers).
* Build and optimise ETL / ELT pipelines ingesting, transforming, and loading data from multiple source systems into Databricks Delta Lake for BI and analytics consumption.
* Develop Power BI reports and dashboards connected to Databricks SQL endpoints delivering clear, accurate, and actionable business insights.
* Design and maintain dimensional data models including star and snowflake schemas aligned to data warehouse and BI best practices.
* Implement and manage Unity Catalog for data governance, access control, data lineage, and metadata management across Databricks workspaces.
* Configure and manage Databricks workflows, jobs, and cluster optimisation ensuring reliable, cost\-efficient pipeline execution at scale.
* Conduct Databricks performance tuning including query optimisation, Delta table compaction, Z\-ordering, and caching strategies.
* Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and business stakeholders translating reporting requirements into well\-designed Databricks and BI solutions.
* Implement data quality frameworks within Databricks ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and consistency across analytical pipelines.
* Produce clear technical documentation including pipeline design documents, data dictionaries, and deployment guides.

**What We're Looking For**


* 10\+ years of BI and data engineering experience with deep hands\-on Databricks expertise in production enterprise environments.


* Strong Databricks platform proficiency including PySpark, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, Notebooks, Workflows, and Unity Catalog.


* Solid Medallion Architecture experience designing and implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers for scalable analytical platforms.


* Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, data transformation, and performance tuning within Databricks and relational databases.


* Strong Python skills for data pipeline development, automation, and Databricks notebook engineering.


* Proven Power BI development skills including DAX, Power Query, data modelling, and Databricks SQL endpoint integration.


* Strong Azure experience including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, and Azure Databricks in production environments.


* Good data governance knowledge including Unity Catalog, data lineage, metadata management, and access control.


* Strong dimensional modelling expertise including star and snowflake schema design aligned to BI best practices.


* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills translating complex data requirements into well\-designed analytical solutions.

title: SDE II, Last Mile
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.  

  

UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. Node Receive COD team handles the process of receiving packages, routing them back to right origin, and handling Cash on delivery reconciliations and liabilities among driver, station and bank.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As an SDE\-2, you will develop a deep understanding of our business, work closely with development teams and own the architecture and end\-to\-end delivery of software components. Senior Engineers provide technical leadership at Amazon. They help establish technical standards and drive Amazon’s overall technical architecture, engineering practices, and methodologies. They work on our hard problems, building high quality, architecturally sound systems that are aligned with our business needs. They think globally when building systems, ensuring Amazon builds high performing, scalable systems that work well together. Senior engineers are pragmatic visionaries who can translate business needs into workable technology solutions. Their expertise is deep and broad. They are hands on, producing both detailed technical work and high\-level architectural designs.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
